stream_render_commits.description: Total React commits during streaming updates (Target: <= 10 commits via RAF batching)

redundant_cell_rerenders.description: Historical cell re-render count during stream (Target: strictly 0)

stream_total_parse_ms.description: Cumulative AST parse duration across 250 tokens (Target: < 2.5 ms)

js_event_loop_lag_ms.description: JavaScript event-loop delay under active streaming load (Target: < 4.0 ms)

sqlite_insert_duration_ms.description: SQLite insert duration p50 in WAL mode (Target: < 3.0 ms)

sqlite_query_duration_ms.description: SQLite 30-message history query duration p50 (Target: < 5.0 ms)

sqlite_write_batch_efficiency.description: SQLite write batch count during 250-token stream (Target: <= 5 writes)

sync_blocking_invariant_ms.description: Synchronous dispatch delay before optimistic state commit (Target: < 4.0 ms)
